coverage.description: Open-source Papyrus compiler useful as an independent compiler and deterministic CI surface.
known_gaps: Caprica deliberately differs from Bethesda compiler in some language behavior
v0.3.0 notes that PPJ files are not fully supported, so it is not a complete Creation Kit compiler replacement
coverage.denominator_probe: PSC files requested vs PEX outputs and compiler diagnostics.

safety.sandbox_or_scope: Compile into isolated build directory; never overwrite canonical PSC.

ai.context_cost_notes: Best used as a second compiler/oracle, not as proof that runtime native dependencies exist.

evidence.notes: Current release page observed v0.3.0 with Skyrim support and pcompiler-compatible CLI mode.
